change_summary: Make the external-Agent disclosure decision evidence-based and weakly stated: ordinary operational metadata is not sensitive by category, while real secrets, regulated data, restrictions, and local-only intent remain excluded.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.15 puts the content-based disclosure decision beside attachment intent and removes command-like MUST wording without weakening sensitive, reference-only, transient, or local-only controls.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; the server advertises Skill and Plugin 1.7.15 without widening authority or changing MCP schemas.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.15 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.15.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator and vague prompts remain unchanged; the Harness now grades broad category-based disclosure refusal as a false negative while retaining real sensitive and local-only countercases.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill and package identity, weak initialization wording, content-based disclosure classification, attachment source preservation, and the unchanged host-neutral matrix denominator.
